experiment: 15N constant-time CPMG relaxation dispersion at 800 and 900 MHz
buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM DTT, 10% (v/v) D2O
construct_or_mutation: human CRABP2 residues 1-137 (cleaved from Thio-His6-TEV fusion)
other_conditions: 1.0 mM 15N CRABP2; 11 CPMG frequencies 0-1000 Hz, Trelax 30 ms; 16-residue group fitted jointly; regime (authors): intermediate (us-ms) time scale; related structures: 2FS6 (free crystal), 2FR3 (atRA-bound crystal)
timescale: kex = 320 ± 40 s-1 (global two-state Carver-Richards fit, 16-residue core group; errors from jackknife)
author_claim: Free CRABP2 shows widespread us-ms exchange, mainly in the portal and gap regions; the invisible state is structurally distinct from the atRA-bound complex and is not rate-limiting for binding.
anchor: The average k ex and p B values obtained from global fitting were 320 ± 40 s −1 and 0.2 ± 0.03, respectively.
locator: Results, CRABP2 Shows Significantly Enhanced Microsecond to Millisecond Dynamics (Figure 5, Table S1); conditions: Methods, Relaxation Measurements
caveat_note: Per-residue fits are in Table S1 of the Supplement, which could not be retrieved. Residues outside the core group show exchange that this single kex/pB does not explain; unassigned broadened residues (E13, E16, R29, A34-A36, K38, V41, T56-V58, T60, N115, V133) lie near them. Sheet card: 298 K, 900 MHz.

experiment: 15N constant-time CPMG relaxation dispersion at 800 and 900 MHz (figure data at 21.14 T)
buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM DTT, 10% (v/v) D2O
ligand_or_partner: all-trans retinoic acid (atRA), 1.5-fold molar excess; DMSO below 1.5%
other_conditions: 1.0 mM complex; complex is partly dimeric (tau_c 15.1 ns); regime (authors): fast fluctuation distinct from the free-protein process; related structures: 2FR3, 2FS6
author_claim: With atRA the us-ms dispersion is nearly completely quenched for the core group and most other residues, leaving a distinct fast fluctuation at a few residues.
anchor: The intermediate-time scale dynamics is nearly completely quenched ( Figure 5D ), for the principal group identified above, and most other residues.
locator: Results, CRABP2 Shows Significantly Enhanced Microsecond to Millisecond Dynamics (Figure 5D, Figure S4)
caveat_note: Ligand-bound sample, not the free deposit sample. The residual fast fluctuation is not fitted in the main text, and the complex self-associates, so the quenching may combine rigidification and dimerization effects.

experiment: 15N R1, R2 and 15N-{1H} NOE at 800 and 900 MHz (per-experiment field not stated)
buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM DTT, 10% (v/v) D2O
other_conditions: 1.0 mM 15N CRABP2; tumbling: tau_c = 10.4 ns; mean NOE 0.82 ± 0.05, R2 19.45 ± 1.50 s-1, R1 0.8 ± 0.06 s-1 (Table 2); related structures: 2FS6
author_claim: The beta G-beta H loop including the SUMOylation site Lys101 stays flexible on the fast time scale in both free and atRA-bound CRABP2.
anchor: However, the β G− β H connecting loop, including the SUMOylation site Lys101, stays flexible in both states.
locator: Results, fast-time scale dynamics (Figure 3, Table 2); conditions: Methods, Relaxation Measurements
caveat_note: Only the K101 loop is named as flexible; mean values are given in Table 2, per-residue values only in Figure 3.

experiment: 15N R1, R2 and 15N-{1H} NOE at 800 and 900 MHz (per-experiment field not stated)
buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM DTT, 10% (v/v) D2O
other_conditions: 1.0 mM complex; tumbling: tau_c = 15.1 ns; mean NOE 0.81 ± 0.06, R2 29.94 ± 2.72 s-1, R1 0.61 ± 0.04 s-1 (Table 2); related structures: 2FR3
author_claim: atRA binding raises R2 and lowers R1 because the complex dimerizes; R1 changes at the beta C-beta D and beta E-beta F loops show fast dynamics quenched there.
anchor: Changes in the R 1 rates at the β C− β D (Arg59– Glu62) and β E− β F loops (Val76 and Asp77) suggest that fast-time scale dynamics have been quenched in these locations upon atRA binding.
caveat_note: The tau_c of 15.1 ns versus 10.4 ns for free CRABP2 reflects self-association (dimer Kd about 1.0 ± 0.2 mM from CSPs), so R1 and R2 changes mix rigidification with larger size. Ligand-bound sample.
